sourceFields.SampleCollectionMethod/MethodDescription: Fish were sampled by daytime electrofishing along two 500-m shoreline transects. A single boom extended 2.5-3.0 m from the front of the boat with a single anode dropper affixed to the end of the boom. From the top of zone, proceed slowly downriver for a minimum of 1800 seconds (0.5 h) of total shock time, following a serpentine path parallel to the shoreline (<30 m from shore or < 6m deep); attempt to net all stunned fish. Place stunned fish in an aerated live well.
sourceFields.ResultCommentText: Common name=silver carp; species weight=27.48; total fish caught=56; total sample weight=61.955

sourceFields.SampleCollectionMethod/MethodDescription: Fish and Ephibenthic Invertebrate Collection Fish trawls were conducted at each site to collect fish/shellfish for community structure and abundance estimates, target species for contaminant analyses, and specimens for histopathological examination. Trawls were conducted by using a 16-ft otter trawl and the duration of the trawl will be for 10±2 minutes; replicate (two) trawls will be performed. In open water, the trawl should be conducted in a straight line with the site location near center. The speed over bottom should be approximately 3-4 knots.
